proposed_common_crop.reason: At1.75s/frame42 the tote's outermost viewer-right corner is around sourcex590–593, at/just beyond the crop right bound590; there is no useful breathing room. Coordinates are manual estimates from original-size images, not automated segmentation.

alternative_common_crop.evidence: All25 wider-window checkpoints and original-size wider frame42 retain full head, shoes, hands, skirt and tote with visible space right of the tote. Applying same rect to A/B preserves common proportional panel scale; constant crop only.
alternative_common_crop.limits: Individual frames between checkpoints not visually inspected; assembled film and normal-speed viewing need separate review.

observations.identity: Broadly stable recognizable face/hair with smile and small head-angle change; no obvious sampled instantaneous face substitution.
observations.wardrobe: Mist-blue open shirt, navy square neckline, waist seam and calf-length skirt remain clear; no obvious sampled outfit mixture or shoulder slip. Dress straps are partially covered and no strap-width claim is added.
observations.feet_and_action: Opening includes small foot/stance changes and mild body angle/weight shift; not stationary feet or exact choreography matching A. Both shoes remain visible in sampled crops; ground contact/fine morphing not certified by stills.
observations.bag_hands: Gray tote swings/lifts outward around1.25–2s as the bag hand adjusts the strap; the outer bag silhouette changes with pose. Larger outward movement than A, causing the narrow-window problem. Fine fingers, strap contacts and seams remain unverified between samples.
observations.camera_and_background: Window/shelf/bench/table appear broadly stable in sampled full frames. Mild subject size/position changes can follow stance/action; no claim of exactly constant human scale. No obvious sampled additional object or major scene warp.
